title.zh: 真实数据，也会被尺度放大

subtitle.zh: 坐标轴 · 本周公开数据

claim.zh: 2023 年，日本的预期寿命远高于韩国
claim.en: In 2023, life expectancy in Japan is far higher than in South Korea

prompt.zh: 截断纵轴后的柱高公平支持“远高于”吗？
prompt.en: Does the cropped bar height fairly support "far higher"?

explanation.zh: 公开数据分别约为 84.3 与 84.7 年，相差 0.4 年。当前截断范围把视觉差异放大约 5.3 倍；数据真实不等于呈现方式自动公平。
explanation.en: The public values are about 84.3 and 84.7 years, a gap of 0.4 years. The cropped range amplifies the visual difference about 5.3 times; real data does not automatically make a presentation fair.

checklist.zh: 核对纵轴起点和完整量程
checklist.en: Check the baseline and full scale

checklist.zh: 把形容词与实际差值对照
checklist.en: Compare the wording with the numeric gap

misconception.zh: 因为数据真实就忽略了呈现尺度
misconception.en: Assume real data guarantees a fair scale

source.name: Our World in Data

subtitle.zh: 坐标轴 · 世界银行数据

claim.zh: 2024 年，澳大利亚的互联网使用率显著高于英国
claim.en: In 2024, internet use in Australia is dramatically higher than in United Kingdom

prompt.zh: 当前纵轴是否把差值讲得过头？
prompt.en: Does the current axis overstate the difference?

explanation.zh: 两项公开数据约为 95.5 和 96.1，实际差值 0.6。截断范围使视觉差异约放大 12.5 倍，因此“显著高于”超过了图中数值能支持的程度。
explanation.en: The public values are about 95.5 and 96.1, a gap of 0.6. The cropped range amplifies the visual difference about 12.5 times, so “dramatically higher” goes beyond what the values support.

checklist.en: Read the values before comparing bar height

checklist.zh: 检查来源年份和指标单位
checklist.en: Check the source year and indicator unit

misconception.zh: 把截断后的柱高当成实际比例
misconception.en: Treat cropped bar height as the real proportion

source.name: World Bank
source.attribution: World Bank, World Development Indicators: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)

subtitle.zh: 相关性 · 本周公开数据

claim.zh: 2023 年这些国家中，收入越高，寿命就越稳定地增长
claim.en: Across these countries in 2023, higher income consistently means longer life

prompt.zh: 一个相关系数足以支持“稳定”吗？
prompt.en: Is one correlation coefficient enough to claim consistency?

explanation.zh: 当前样本的相关系数约为 0.90；移除最敏感的数据点后约为 0.82。相关性还受国家选择、年份、遗漏变量和指标定义影响，不能只用一个系数概括。
explanation.en: The correlation is about 0.90; without the most influential point it is about 0.82. Country selection, year, omitted variables, and indicator definitions still matter, so one coefficient is not enough.

checklist.zh: 比较包含与排除敏感点的结果
checklist.en: Compare results with and without the influential point

checklist.zh: 核对样本选择与遗漏变量
checklist.en: Check sample selection and omitted variables

misconception.zh: 把一个相关系数当成稳定规律
misconception.en: Treat one correlation coefficient as a stable rule

source.name: Our World in Data
source.license: CC BY 4.0; underlying provider terms apply

title.zh: 同向变化不是完整解释
title.en: Moving together is not the full story

subtitle.zh: 相关性 · 世界银行数据

claim.zh: 2024 年样本证明了人均收入与互联网使用率存在稳定关系
claim.en: The 2024 sample proves a stable relationship between income per person and internet use

prompt.zh: 当前散点和相关系数足以称为“证明”吗？
prompt.en: Are this scatter and coefficient enough to call it "proof"?

explanation.zh: 当前相关系数约为 0.76，移除最敏感点后约为 0.57。即使方向没有改变，横截面相关仍不能说明机制、时间顺序或因果。
explanation.en: The correlation is about 0.76, and about 0.57 without the most influential point. Even if the direction remains, cross-sectional correlation does not establish mechanism, timing, or causation.

checklist.zh: 查看散点而不是只读 r
checklist.en: Inspect the points instead of reading r alone

misconception.zh: 把横截面相关称为因果证明
